s.how: Shape 500g beef mince into 12 small patties and season. Cook on a hot pan for 2 minutes a side, adding half a cheese slice each at the end. Put in 12 slider buns with pickles and sauce.
Cut 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks, 1 cucumber and 1 red capsicum into sticks and stand them in jars. Blitz 200g sour cream with parsley, chives and a squeeze of lemon for the dip.

m.how: Mix 2 tbsp chipotle in adobo, 2 crushed garlic cloves, the juice of 1 lime, 1 tsp cumin and 2 tbsp oil. Marinate 800g chicken thigh fillets for 30 minutes. Slice 1 red onion thin and soak in lime juice and salt for 20 minutes. Grill the chicken on a hot barbecue for 5 minutes a side and slice. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Warm 12 small tortillas and fill with avocado, chicken, onion and coriander.

w.note: the neon of the Roxbury dance floor
w.how: Crush 150g plain sweet biscuits and mix with 60g melted butter. Press into 6 glasses. Blitz 150g raspberries with 2 tbsp icing sugar and strain. Beat 250g cream cheese with 80g icing sugar and 1 tsp vanilla, then fold in 200ml whipped cream. Fold half the raspberry sauce through to turn it pink. Spoon into the glasses, swirl the rest of the sauce on top and chill 2 hours. Finish with raspberries and grated white chocolate.

d.how: Shake 40ml vodka, 15ml orange liqueur, 30ml cranberry juice and 10ml lime juice with ice for each glass. Strain into 4 chilled glasses. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
